sub_sector.value: Gas and electric utilities; power generation; coal mining

industry_position.detail: Regulated natural gas distribution and electric service, plus power generation and coal mining that primarily supply its electric utilities.

commodity_exposure.detail: Distributes natural gas, generates and delivers electricity, and produces coal for power generation.

revenue_structure.detail: Utility rates are regulated. Power generation and coal mining primarily supply electric utility operations under long-term contracts.

energy_transition.detail: Natural gas distribution, coal mining, and electricity generation from coal, natural gas, and wind.
